title: Feelings of emotion are patterned homeostatic shifts

statements.text: Feelings of emotion, such as fear or excitement, are patterned combinations of homeostatic shifts in response to challenges to internal stability or chances to improve it, as when a raised heart rate and metabolic demand before a predator contribute to fear.
